changelog:
nansen-mpp-payment 1.0.0

- Initial release introducing pay-per-call access to the Nansen API via MPP (Tempo).
- Enables anonymous API access without requiring a Nansen API key or managing a Base/Solana wallet.
- Provides setup instructions for the separate tempo CLI to handle authentication and payment.
- Includes examples for common Nansen API calls using tempo.
- Describes how MPP via tempo differs from existing x402 and API key methods.
- Outlines use cases and fallback recommendations when MPP is not available server-side.
summary: Pay-per-call access to the Nansen API via MPP (Tempo). Use when a user wants anonymous Nansen access without an API key and without managing their own Base/S...
